title: "Schedule"

Topics and readings by week. **Due dates are in Canvas only.** Lecture notebooks
are linked here as each week is posted.

Readings come from two free QuantEcon lecture series:
[Python Programming for Economics and Finance](https://python-programming.quantecon.org)
(**PP**) and
[A First Course in Quantitative Economics with Python](https://intro.quantecon.org)
(**FC**).
